title: Ollie's Secret Garden
moral: Sharing and teamwork make adventures special.

scenes.summary: Ollie finds a key and begins an adventure.
scenes.text: Ollie finds a shiny key and decides to search for a hidden treasure with Daisy.
scenes.image_prompt: boy holding key with dog in garden cartoon style
scenes.story: Ollie found a shiny key and went on an adventure with his dog Daisy. They followed clues into a tunnel leading to a secret garden. There they found a treasure chest filled with beautiful items. Ollie shared the experience by drawing and inviting friends to join. He learned teamwork and friendship make the best treasure.
